prompt: A weathered verdigris-bronze tidal sluice-gate built into dark wet basalt rocks, seen three-quarter view, channeling rushing seawater through its open arched channel. The water glows luminous cerulean where it pours through the bronze conduit, foaming white at the edges. The background is a misty grey-blue sea under an overcast sky. The only strong light is the cerulean glow of the channeled tide-water.

A circular brass-and-iron intake ring half-submerged in the sea, viewed from above at an angle, with a swirling cerulean whirlpool of seawater spiraling down into its dark center. Verdigris-stained metal vanes radiate around the vortex. White foam rings the spinning water. The background is open deep-blue ocean. The only light source is the glowing turquoise heart of the whirlpool.

A ruined half-submerged island shrine of pale marble and oxidized bronze, seen in wide view, with the rising tide pouring through a carved central channel cut into its base. The channeled seawater glows sapphire as it streams through the conduit. Barnacled stone pillars frame the flow. The background is a calm misty sea and low grey horizon, like a quiet seascape. Soft sapphire light rises from the channeled water.

A close-up of a great verdigris-bronze conduit spout shaped like a stylized fish-mouth, jutting from mossy stone, gushing a thick stream of glowing cerulean seawater downward onto wet black rocks below, throwing up white spray and turquoise mist. Riveted weathered brass plating frames the spout. The background is dim sea-cave stone. The only light is the cerulean glow of the pouring tide-water.

A wide quiet seascape: a slender bronze aqueduct-channel runs across foreground tide-pools on a rocky shore, carrying a thread of glowing turquoise seawater toward the viewer. Distant misty blue-grey crags rise from a calm cyan sea under a soft pale sky, echoing a tranquil island vista. The channeled water is the brightest element, glowing faint turquoise against the muted cool palette.

A massive arched stone-and-bronze tidal gate, side profile, straddling a narrow sea channel, its raised iron portcullis-grate letting a powerful surge of glowing cerulean seawater rush through underneath in a torrent of white foam. Verdigris-streaked masonry and brass machinery flank the arch. The background is open grey sea and overcast sky. Cerulean light pours from the rushing channeled tide.

A weathered brass tidal-engine of pipes, valves and a great spoked verdigris wheel mounted on barnacled stone pilings over the sea, three-quarter view, with glowing cerulean seawater being drawn up through its riveted pipes and venting in a luminous turquoise jet. Wet oxidized metalwork gleams. The background is a calm misty blue-grey sea and low horizon. The channeled glowing water is the brightest element.

A circular verdigris-bronze ring-portal set into a dark wet basalt sea-cliff, three-quarter view, with a torrent of glowing cerulean seawater pouring out through it and cascading into a foaming sea below. The bronze ring is studded with rivets and barnacles. The background is misty grey-blue ocean under an overcast sky. The only strong light is the cerulean glow of the channeled tide-water.

A lone bronze-domed lighthouse-conduit standing on a small rocky island at dusk, its base ringed by glowing turquoise channels that draw the surrounding tide inward in radiating luminous streams across the wet rocks. Verdigris metal dome and arched windows. The background is a deep indigo twilight sea and faint stars. The turquoise channeled tide-streams are the brightest light in the scene.

A grand bronze tidal-conduit arch of stacked aqueduct channels built into a rocky coast, three-quarter view, seawater glowing cerulean as it threads through the stepped conduits and spills in tiers down to a foaming sea. Verdigris-streaked stone and brass. The background is a wide misty blue sea and pale overcast sky. Cerulean glow rises from the channeled tide flowing through the structure.
